title: JsonReport
description: Everything `check` found, for a tool to read.

version.description: The contract's version, 1 for this shape.

root.description: The repository's root, absolute. Each finding's path is relative to it.

failsCheck.description: Whether a finding failed its trait's threshold, which is when `check` exits 1.

findings.description: One per snippet and trait that applies to it, passes included.

nonUtf8Paths.description: Paths that aren't valid UTF-8, shown as near as they can be. They weren't judged.

JsonFinding.description: One trait's verdict on one snippet.

path.description: The file, relative to the root, with `/` between its parts.

firstLine.description: The snippet's first line, counting from 1.

trait.description: The trait's slug: its folder's name under `.agents/traits/`.

why.description: Why the trait matters, from its `TRAIT.md`.

pFail.description: How likely the snippet fails the trait, from 0 to 1.

threshold.description: The trait's threshold in `.agents/traitor.json`, or null when its fails are only reported.

fromCache.description: Whether the verdict came from traitor's cache instead of a new request.

JsonVerdict.description: Jev's answer, named as Jev names it.
